model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing training rewards over steps for two different models—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—on two distinct training sets: Easy and Hard. Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps," which ranges from 0 to 500 on a linear scale with tick marks every 100 steps. The y-axis in both plots is labeled "Training Rewards" and uses a linear scale; in the top plot (Easy Training Set), it ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 with tick marks every 0.1, while in the bottom plot (Hard Training Set), it ranges from 0.0 to 0.2 with tick marks every 0.05. In the top plot, the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) starts at approximately 0.0 and increases to around 0.35 by step 500, with minor fluctuations. The red line (Llama-LUFFY-Easy) begins at 0.0, rises to about 0.25 by step 100, and then continues to increase to approximately 0.4 by step 500, showing slightly higher rewards than the teal line after step 200. Both lines have shaded regions around them, indicating uncertainty or variance. In the bottom plot, the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) starts at 0.0, rises slightly to about 0.03 by step 50, and then drops to near 0.0 by step 100, remaining flat thereafter. The red line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) starts at 0.0, increases steadily to about 0.1 by step 100, and continues to rise to approximately 0.2 by step 500, with some fluctuations. The shaded regions around both lines in the bottom plot also represent uncertainty.
